boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, university-documented places for quiet work, group sessions, academic help, or study breaks at Saint Francis University.

cards.entity_name: Library & Learning Commons Quiet Study Rooms
cards.title: Library & Learning Commons Quiet Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Library & Learning Commons, Saint Francis University
cards.notes: Start here when you need a low-distraction setting. The university’s library tour specifically identifies quiet study rooms among the spaces students can explore.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated quiet rooms within the Library & Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: A Saint Francis University library tour describes quiet study rooms in the Library & Learning Commons.
cards.source_title: Student Support Services: Get to the SFU Library
cards.access_notes: The cited session was for students; current room availability and any booking rules are not stated on the source.

cards.entity_name: Library & Learning Commons Open Study Areas
cards.title: Library & Learning Commons Open Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Library & Learning Commons, Saint Francis University
cards.notes: Use the library’s open study areas for individual work with a little ambient activity. Pair a work block with research help if you need it.
cards.short_summary: Shared open study areas in the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: A Saint Francis University library tour identifies open study areas in the Library & Learning Commons.
cards.source_title: Student Support Services: Get to the SFU Library
cards.access_notes: The cited session was for students; current seating availability is not stated on the source.

cards.entity_name: Library & Learning Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Library & Learning Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Library & Learning Commons, Saint Francis University
cards.notes: Bring a project team or course partner to a group study room. Check with library staff before relying on a room for a scheduled meeting.
cards.short_summary: Library rooms intended for group work and discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University’s library policy lists group study rooms among Library facilities.
cards.access_notes: The policy confirms the rooms but does not state reservation procedures; contact the Library & Learning Commons for current use rules.

cards.title: Library & Learning Commons Seminar Rooms
cards.subtitle: Library & Learning Commons, Saint Francis University
cards.notes: Consider a seminar room for a focused small-group session. Ask library staff about scheduling before planning a presentation or extended collaboration.
cards.short_summary: Seminar-capable rooms in the university library.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University’s library policy lists group study and seminar rooms among Library facilities.
cards.access_notes: The policy confirms seminar rooms but does not publish current reservation or access requirements.

cards.entity_name: Library & Learning Commons Public Computer Lab
cards.title: Library & Learning Commons Public Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Library & Learning Commons, Saint Francis University
cards.notes: Choose the public computer lab when your work needs a campus workstation. Bring files in a cloud account or portable storage for a smoother session.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University’s library policy lists a public computer lab among Library facilities.
cards.access_notes: The policy confirms the lab; equipment availability and any login requirements are not stated on the source.

cards.title: Tutoring Center
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Library & Learning Commons
cards.notes: Book a one-to-one or group tutoring session when course material has stalled. Walk-ins are also accepted on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.short_summary: Peer-tutoring workspace for individual or group academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tutoring Center offers one-to-one or group sessions on the second floor of the Library & Learning Commons, with appointments preferred and walk-ins welcome.
cards.access_notes: For Saint Francis University students. Appointments are preferred; walk-ins are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: First floor, Library & Learning Commons
cards.notes: Bring a draft, outline, or research question for a one-to-one writing consultation. Appointments are preferred, with walk-ins handled as space permits.
cards.short_summary: Consultation space for developing coursework writing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center provides one-to-one consultations in the first-floor Library and Learning Commons, with appointments preferred and walk-ins welcome.
cards.access_notes: For Saint Francis University students. Appointments are preferred; walk-ins are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: JFK Student Center Multipurpose Lounge
cards.subtitle: John F. Kennedy Student Center
cards.notes: Set up for a study meeting or presentation practice in the multipurpose lounge. Its documented uses include small and large group meetings and studying.
cards.short_summary: Flexible lounge space for collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: The JFK Student Center multipurpose lounge is used for small or large group meetings, studying, speakers, and presentations.
cards.access_notes: Located in the JFK Student Center; the source does not state reservation requirements or current availability.

cards.title: Commuter Hub
cards.subtitle: First floor, Padua Hall
cards.notes: Use the tables for a between-class work session, then store materials in the nearby lockers if eligible. The hub also has lounge seating and appliances.
cards.short_summary: Padua Hall hub with tables for studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University lists the Commuter Hub on Padua Hall’s first floor with tables for studying, lockers, lounge seating, and appliances.
cards.access_notes: Presented by the university as a commuter resource; confirm eligibility and locker use with the Center for Student Engagement.

cards.title: Adamucci Café Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Bottom level, Schwab Hall
cards.notes: Choose the study tables at Adamucci Café for a work session near coffee and snacks. Keep the visit focused on its documented table workspace.
cards.short_summary: Study tables in Schwab Hall’s café area.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis University identifies Adamucci Café on Schwab Hall’s bottom level as having coffee, snacks, and study tables.
cards.access_notes: Located on the bottom level of Schwab Hall. The source does not state whether a purchase is needed to use tables or current operating hours.
